title: Mrs. Penguin's Perfect Palace
summary: The Penguin family lives on the beach among piles of garbage, until one day Mrs. Penguin announces: we need a home! But how do you build a home on the beach?
pages:
"I wish I had a home!" said Mrs. Penguin. "I don't like living in garbage."
"Dear Mrs. Penguin," said Papa Penguin, "we will build you a palace."

So the Penguin family got to work.
"The sand is itchy," grumbled Sissy.
"The sizes are wrong," said Bossy.
"I'm hungry," said Greedy.
Mrs. Penguin sighed. She did all the work by herself.

At last the palace was ready.
But the tide came in, and the sea washed it away.
"Let's try again," said Papa Penguin.

"Come on, children, let's build Mama a fancy house of stone."
So the Penguin family got to work.

"The stones are heavy," grumbled Sissy.
"The sizes are wrong," said Bossy.
"I'm still hungry," said Greedy.

At last the house was ready.
But the wind began to blow and knocked it down.
Mrs. Penguin was cross.
"I'm not working anymore," she said.

"Let's try again," said Papa. "I don't have any ideas," said Sissy. "It's too hard."
"We don't have any cement," said Bossy. "You can't build a real house without cement."
"I'm hungry," said Greedy.
Mrs. Penguin sighed. She would never have a home.

"Look at all this mess," she said.
And then Mrs. Penguin had an idea.

"Bossy, bring some wood," she said.
"Sissy, look for nets."
"Greedy, collect plastic.
Papa, bring the hammer."
They worked all day long.

"I'm tired," said Sissy.
"Keep working," said Mama.
"The sizes are wrong," said Bossy.
"Keep working," said Mama.
"I'm still hungry," said Greedy.
"Keep working," said Mama.

"This is going to be wonderful," said Papa.
"You're all working very nicely," said Mama.
So they worked and worked and worked and worked...
...and at last the house was ready.
"Welcome to your palace," said Papa. Mrs. Penguin clapped her flippers. "Thank you," she said. "This is Mrs. Penguin's perfect palace."
